verdict.rationale: Clerk publishes llms.txt files at several scopes: a probe confirmed HTTP 200 for https://clerk.com/llms.txt, and the pack cites llms-full.txt, docs/llms.txt, dashboard llms.txt and changelog llms.txt. It also serves markdown docs (probe hit /docs.md, and appending .md works on any docs, blog or changelog URL) and markets an /agents page about handing its docs to Claude Code or Codex. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents successfully consuming these docs.
